description: VN→ZH double question-marking: an A-not-A question (是不是 / 有没有 / V不V) is already a yes/no question and must not also carry sentence-final 吗. Learners double-mark the question. Rule zh-anot-a-redundant-ma drops the trailing 吗 when the A-not-A immediately follows the leading subject pronoun.
fp_risk_note: Low-medium risk. Fires only when an A-not-A form (是不是/有没有/去不去/…) immediately follows the leading subject pronoun and 吗 is sentence-final. A plain 吗 question ('你是学生吗') has no A-not-A and never matches; an embedded A-not-A under a matrix verb ('你知道他是不是学生吗', where 吗 is correct) never matches because 知道 sits between the pronoun and the A-not-A.

positive.notes: 是不是 A-not-A + 吗 → drop redundant 吗.
有没有 A-not-A + 吗 → drop 吗.
要不要 A-not-A + 吗 → drop 吗 (neutral 'do you want tea').

negative.notes: Plain 吗 question, no A-not-A — 吗 is required, must abstain.
A-not-A with no 吗 — already correct, nothing to drop, must abstain.

negative.input: 你知道他是不是学生吗
negative.expectedCorrection: 你知道他是不是学生吗
negative.notes: Embedded A-not-A under 知道 ('do you know whether he is a student') — 吗 is correct on the matrix question; 知道 between 你 and 是不是 blocks the rule, must abstain.
